verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat product, so threaded replies apply. The only evidence that threads exist is indirect: Block's agent benchmark includes a 'reply-to-thread' task graded on 'where the reply lands', and the README says agents 'post the threads'. Neither describes a user-facing thread reply feature that keeps side discussions attached to the original message. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of thread replies for human users (UI or CLI), any description of how threads attach to and display under parent messages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
